description: This is a Java JUnit test class for the ImmutableSubject class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package. It tests the immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and creation methods of the ImmutableSubject class. The class uses libraries such as AssertJ, Mutability Detector, EqualsVerifier, and JUnit.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjectTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutableSubject, verifying its immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and creation methods.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableSubject is immutable and that its component classes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the correctness of equals and hashCode methods of ImmutableSubject.

methods.name: testToAndFromJson
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableSubject can be serialized to JSON and deserialized back to an equivalent object.

methods.name: createSubjectWithNullSubjectIssuer
methods.description: Ensures passing null as subject issuer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createSubjectWithNullSubject
methods.description: Ensures passing null as subject throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createSubjectWithNullSubjectId
methods.description: Ensures passing null as subject ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createSubjectWithNullSubjectType
methods.description: Ensures passing null as subject type throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createSubjectSuccess
methods.description: Tests creating a Subject with a custom type and verifies its properties.

methods.name: createSubjectWithUnknownTypeSuccess
methods.description: Tests creating a Subject with the default/generated type.

methods.name: createSubjectWithIssuerSuccess
methods.description: Tests creating a Subject with an issuer, ID, and type, verifying the properties.

methods.name: subjectWithIssuerEqualsSubjectAndIssuer
methods.description: Verifies equality logic when creating Subjects with issuer details.
